texts: A crowd of nightmoths gathers at each lantern-row every night.

fields.sentence: A crowd of nightmoths gathers at each lantern-row every night.
parse: (: crowd_gather_rule (Implication (Member $l lantern_row) (And (Member (sk_crowd $l) crowd) (GroupOf (sk_crowd $l) nightmoth) (Member (sk_gather $l) gather) (Agent (sk_gather $l) (sk_crowd $l)) (Location (sk_gather $l) $l) (Time (sk_gather $l) night) (Every (sk_gather $l) 1 day))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: The 'each' universal over the locative range becomes a distributing rule whose dependent existentials are Skolem functions of $l (one crowd and one gathering per lantern-row), the collective predicate 'gather' correctly stays group-only with no per-member rule, and 'every night' takes the named-slot pair (Time e night) plus (Every e 1 day). Only 'each' gets a QuantifierPhrase companion, which is what the habitual-schedule rule calls for.
